notes: GRAND TOUR: every piece of music re-arranged in place - same public-domain masterpieces in the same spots, with fresh voicings, bass lines and accompaniment, re-measured to sit at the old loudness. SUPER BUDDY CART is a progression now: the circuits stretch from the untouched Bug Meadows oval up to The Unmaintained Depths at 2.4x the length, the roads narrow as you climb, boost pads multiply, tire stacks sit on the racing line in the far country, and both Grand Prix cups inherit the whole ramp.
